texts.close_hint: 30 days to change your mind. Your LynkID is never given to anyone else.
texts.close_requested: Closing on {when}. Sign in before then to keep it.
texts.contact_hint: We sent a 6-digit code. It expires in 10 minutes.
texts.download_hint: Ready within 30 days, then available for 7 days.
texts.exchange_link: Exchange activity is in LynkOmni Exchange.
texts.help_article_1: Lost your phone? How recovery works
texts.keep_one_passkey: Keep at least one passkey. Add another before removing this one.
texts.last_owner_note: The last owner cannot leave. Transfer ownership first.
texts.memberships_body: LynkBooking and LynkEssential memberships appear here when you join one.
texts.never_allowed: Never: SMS alone, security questions, a reset over the phone, email alone.
texts.no_plans: Every plan is on Free. Nothing to pay.
texts.notice_consent: Sharing with your accountant ends in 7 days
texts.notice_signin: New sign-in on an unknown laptop
texts.passkey_hint: A passkey replaces a password. Add one on this device now; add a second device soon.
texts.path_assisted_body: An ID document, proof of the business and a live check. Then a 72-hour wait and approval by two staff members. Never over a phone call.
texts.path_code_body: Enter both codes. Then a 24-hour wait: every enrolled device and your backup contact are told, and any of them can cancel.
texts.path_device_body: Open LynkOmni on the other device and approve with its PIN. You are back in at once.
texts.payslips_empty: No payslips yet. They appear here when an employer pays you through LynkOmni.
texts.recover_question_code: Do you have your recovery code?
texts.recover_question_device: Do you have another phone or computer where you are signed in?
texts.recovery_cancel_note: Any enrolled device or your backup contact can cancel this.
texts.recovery_code_hint: Shown once. Write it on paper and keep it away from your phone. It is never sent to you again.
texts.recovery_code_push: Next: enrol a second device or a co-owner today. It is the fastest way back in.
texts.recovery_restricted: After recovery this device is restricted for 24 hours: no role or payout changes, no removing other devices, no export.
texts.screens_hint: Pick a screen. Sign-up, sign-in and recovery follow the agreed rules: passkeys first, SMS never enough alone, a waiting period people can cancel.
texts.security_always: Security alerts always come through, with no link in them.
texts.sf_age: A Storefront is for people aged {age} or older, or the age of majority where they live.
texts.sf_identity_sent: Sent to the partner. You will be told when they answer.
texts.sf_identity_why: Before your first paid offer, the licensed payment partner checks who you are. Free offers can go up without it.
texts.sf_intro: Offer your products, services, lessons or files to everyone and get paid through licensed payment partners. Your Storefront uses this same account.
texts.sf_plan_line: {plan}: {share} of each Storefront sale, taken by the payment partner
texts.signin_hint: One account for every LynkOmni place.
texts.signin_new_device_note: New device or place? We tell you on every channel, with no link in the message.
texts.signin_passkey_hint: Your phone or computer confirms it is you. No password to remember.
texts.signin_pin: Enter your PIN on an enrolled phone
texts.signup_adult: I am {age} or older, or the age of majority where I live
texts.signup_adult_note: We never ask for your birth date.
texts.standing_intro: A standing payment is your own instruction: a cap you set, held by the licensed provider, and you are told every time it is used.
texts.start_approved: Approved. Your business {lynkoid} is ready in LynkOmni.
texts.start_intro: Register a business, get a tax number and open a business bank account through the government gateway and banks in your country. Free for you; government fees go straight to the government.
texts.start_not_before: Nothing is approved until the authority says so.
texts.start_submitted: Submitted. The authority decides; we show its answer here.
texts.stepup_hint: A fresh check is needed for this. Enter the code we sent.
texts.support_side_note: Questions about selling, offers, buyers and payouts go to seller support. Your priority is the highest of all your plans.
texts.username_change_note: Your old username keeps pointing to you and never goes to anyone else.
texts.wallet_empty: Your wallet is empty. Tickets, vouchers, eSIM codes and points from every shop appear here.
texts.ws_help: The same books, invoices, contacts and reports for yourself, a company or an organisation.
texts.ws_note: Same prices and rules for everyone. No till needed.
